- Result: official index `2`, `race_finish_time_ns=-1`, and collision ID `1001`

- The vehicle still hit the left gate frame. At the last full observation the
  gate was `2.17 m` forward and `0.69 m` left; the `1.5 m` inner aperture plus
  vehicle/attitude clearance requires a tighter centerline than that. Holding
  a modest bank only inside `8 m` did not build lateral rate early enough.

  forward boundary `20.0 m`, not triggered because handoff was never reached.
- Decision: reject the `8 m/+0.22 rad` correction. Retain its proven sign, but
  move the same bounded roll floor earlier/stronger so the vehicle is centered
  before the plane rather than merely converging at impact. Do not re-run the
  same values.

## Phase-0 Finish-Lock Decision — Controlled Finish Authorized

- Official evidence checked 2026-07-16:
  https://www.theaigrandprix.com/ says teams can attempt runs throughout the
  qualification window, reports thousands of completed simulator runs used to
  test and refine autonomy stacks, says the fastest valid times advance, and
  then says the time is locked once all gates are passed. TS-002 separately
  defines a start gate, sequential/intermediate gates, and finish gate.
- Inference, stated explicitly: “locked” finalizes that attempt's elapsed time;
  it is not evidence of an irreversible first-completion team submission.
  Repeated completed runs and fastest-time scoring would otherwise conflict
  with the published iteration model. No public VQ1 leaderboard or cutoff time
  was found, and the local UI exposes only VQ1/R1.
- Operational decision: Candidate 143's `4/5` clean guarded batch is sufficient
  to authorize one deliberate local first finish. Immediately archive official
  finish evidence, stop control on the first nonnegative finish timestamp, and
  prove MAVLink `31000` clears the finish state before any second flight.
- Lifecycle gap fixed: the smoke loop now exits immediately when official
  `race_finish_time_ns >= 0` and records `official_finish_stop` with gate index
  and exact nanosecond/second values. Focused verification is `71 passed`;
  Windows compilation succeeds. Root/Windows smoke files retain their known
  pre-existing adapter differences while sharing this finish-stop logic.

## Course-count Correction — Official R1 Has Six Gates

- User correction on 2026-07-16: official VQ1/R1 contains **six ordered gates**.
  The native four-gate curriculum and historical “Gate 4/final” terminology
  were incorrectly treated as the official course shape.
- Authoritative interpretation: `active_gate_index=3` means Gates 1-3 passed
  and Gate 4 active. Runs through Candidate 206 used target/min index `3`; they
  are Gate-4-entry diagnostics only. None passed Gate 4 (`index>=4`), and lack
  of a finish timestamp is expected while Gates 4-6 remain.
- Architectural defect found: the runner encoded phase with denominator `3`,
  so indices `3-6` collapsed to the same value; the post-prefix callable and
  delayed edge preference also retained one continuous association/delay/pulse
  state across every index `>=3`. That cannot represent Gates 4, 5, and 6 as
  separate targets.
- Freeze live flights. Next implementation must preserve the checkpoint's
  restored previous-yaw input for Gates 1-3 while decoding an official six-gate
  phase, reset post-prefix and edge-preference state on every official gate
  transition, and validate focused/default parity. Resume with target/min index
  `4`; only after Gate 4 passes may Gate 5 and then Gate 6 be mapped. Full-course
  proof requires target/min `6` plus nonnegative `race_finish_time_ns`.

## N190 Stateless Close Gate-2 Vertical Margin — Offline Freeze

- N190 retains N189 source-hash exact and adds one Gate-2-only stateless rule.
  On a visible Gate-2 sample inside `6 m`, it projects current down position to
  the gate plane using a `3 m/s` closing-speed floor. If the projection is
  below `-1.1 m`, normalized thrust is floored at the already validated
  moderate value `+0.3`. It changes no pitch, roll, or yaw, preserves stronger
  thrust, has no latch, and releases immediately when projection recovers.
- Evidence covers Candidates 037--049: eleven clean Gate-2 transitions and the
  two recent contact paths. Both Candidates 047 and 049 receive exactly two
  earlier weak-thrust changes; Candidate 048 remains bit-exact. Five clean
  transitions enter the conservative margin rule, but only weak thrust is
